title: dichoropetalum graminifolium
intro: Dichoropetalum graminifolium, commonly known as 'Grass-leaved Cudweed', is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Apiaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and supporting the immune system.
